referenceNote: This is a translation: in case of any discrepancy, the Italian version prevails.
privacy.where.title: Where your data is
privacy.where.text: Preferences, calendar, pantry, shopping lists and history are saved in a database on your phone. Mina has no servers and doesn’t require an account: no email, password or sign-in with Google or Apple.
privacy.allergies.title: Allergies and preferences
privacy.allergies.text: The ingredients you exclude stay on the device. They are not sent to payment, analytics or advertising services. We don’t ask for weight, height, diagnoses or personal details.
privacy.tracking.title: No analytics or advertising
privacy.tracking.text: The app contains no analytics, tracking or advertising tools and does not use advertising identifiers.
privacy.notifications.title: Notifications
privacy.notifications.text: Reminders are local notifications scheduled by the phone itself. No server sends messages.
privacy.backup.title: Phone backup
privacy.backup.text: The app’s database may be included in your phone’s backups (iCloud or computer on iPhone, your Google account backup on Android), according to the settings you have chosen. It’s your backup: Mina does not receive it.
privacy.export.title: Export or delete
privacy.export.text: From Profile you can export all your data in JSON format or delete it permanently. After deletion, the app starts again from the initial questionnaire.
privacy.subscription.title: Subscription
privacy.subscription.text: Purchases are not active today and the app does not contact any payment service. When they are, payments will be handled by Apple or Google; the subscription status will be verified through RevenueCat using an anonymous app identifier and the store receipt. Your food preferences will never be shared.
privacy.footer: Mina is not a medical device and does not provide dietary or nutritional advice. The full privacy policy will be published before distribution in the stores.
terms.status.title: Current status
terms.status.text: In this trial version subscriptions are not active: no payment is requested or charged.
terms.price.title: Price and period
terms.price.text: When subscriptions are active, the price, period (monthly or annual) and any free trials will be shown before purchase, read directly from the store.
terms.renewal.title: Automatic renewal
terms.renewal.text: The subscription renews automatically at the end of each period unless cancelled at least 24 hours before, from your Apple or Google Play account settings.
terms.cancel.title: Cancellation and refunds
terms.cancel.text: You can cancel at any time from the store settings; the subscription remains active until the end of the paid period. Refunds are handled by Apple or Google according to their rules.
terms.restore.title: Restore
terms.restore.text: You don’t need a Mina account: the subscription is linked to your store account. On a new phone, use “Restore purchases” on the subscription screen.
terms.data.title: Your data
terms.data.text: Saved recipes, pantry and history stay on your phone even if the subscription expires. To move them to another phone, use your phone’s backup or the export from Profile.
terms.footer: The full terms of service will be published before distribution in the stores.
legal.provider.title: Who provides Mina
legal.provider.missing: To be completed before publication: name or company name, address, contact email and phone number (for sales in the European Union, the stores also show them on the app’s page).
legal.nature.title: Nature of the service
legal.nature.text: Mina helps you plan meals, recipes, shopping and pantry. It is not a medical device and does not provide dietary, nutritional or therapeutic advice.
